premises: Lattice distortions in HEAs alter plasma frequency and relaxation time, reducing electronic conductivity relative to linear combinations.
Oxygen contamination above ~1 wt.% in HfNbTaTiZr prevents single-phase solid solution formation and causes embrittlement.
Force-constant disorder is a dominant phonon scattering source in HEAs, analogous to glasses.
Low and weakly temperature-dependent thermal conductivity in glasses is linked to strong phonon scattering from intrinsic disorder.
The cited evidence supports the need to model atomic-scale disorder and oxygen defects for accurate transport predictions.
